review_note: Resolved to the senior Danish defender Mathias Jattah-Njie Jørgensen (Zanka), not the separate 2000-born Danish striker of the same name. This matches this historical FPL row's Brentford club and code 48760. Do not reject the match because the current P54 list is incomplete or stale. The scoped PL roster is data/raw/premier_league_api/players/2024-25.
